name: edit_file
description: Replace an exact occurrence of old_string with new_string in an existing file. Set replace_all to true to replace every occurrence. Use absolute paths. When the user does not specify a location, default to the current working directory from the system context. Example: {"path":"<cwd>/output/profile.html","old_string":"Hello","new_string":"Hi"}

path.description: Absolute path of the file to edit. Default to the current working directory when no path is given.

replace_all.description: If true, replace all occurrences of old_string.
